Yaseen Photo Editor is a photography and editing studio in Wazirabad. We shoot portraits, couples, weddings and birthdays, and we retouch the photos you already have — fixing light, skin, colour and backgrounds until they are ready to print or post.

From a quick background swap to a full wedding set — everything is edited by hand, not with a one-tap filter.
